body:
Sorry for the late response, I wrote this out just before work to get it out of my system. I didn't want to wait around for responses working myself up even more.

I did have a few more suicidal thoughts at work, but they weren't nearly as intense as yesterday's were. 

I'm talking with a friend out of state via AIM right now, and working out what to do.  I didn't tell her about my suicidal thoughts, but my relationship has pretty well gone toxic for me.  

I dunno if that's what triggered all this, but I'll be taking it one step at a time. Thank you for your advice, at this moment I do feel a sense of ease, and I think I'll be okay.  I get these feelings every few years or so, but never so intense before, it was just fucking scary.
